posts.title: Making my Non-Magnetic Refrigerator Magnetic
posts.description: It's my fridge, now with magnets! One of the worst mistakes I've made in my whole life was buying a home, not realizing that the refrigerator doors were not magnetic. It had never even occurred to me that a refrigerator would not be able to hold a magnet. It's like buying a car and then realizing later that it doesn't have a radio in it. posts.title: Side Projects are Too Easy
posts.description: This is my latest project that lasted a whole hour You know the thing about how software developers are always starting side projects and never finishing them, and how they always have a bunch of domain names that they'll never get rid of? I honestly don't know if that's true anymore. With LLMs we've come upon a golden age of side projects! The problem is that they're too easy!
